snippets.caption: Extension imports, option types, and wizard state definitions.
Snippet resolution reads local file ranges and records warnings instead of embedding code in JSON.
Codebase template composes status, file map, workflows, data flows, focus, snippets, and validation sections.
CSS is composed from importable style modules without adding a bundler.

reviewFocus.question: Are snippets short, relevant, and referenced by line range rather than duplicated into JSON?
Do reusable components explain current code responsibilities and flows clearly without falling back to raw diffs?

risks.description: Snippet line ranges can drift as files change after JSON generation.
risks.mitigation: Use mustContain anchors for important snippets and surface resolver warnings.

decisions.decision: Use snippet references instead of inline code.
decisions.rationale: This saves model output tokens and lets the CLI read authoritative code from disk at render time.
